description: Principal Pedestrian Network Map is a dataset listed in Lake Macquarie open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Lake Macquarie City Council. This map shows the extent of Principal Pedestrian Networks defined for the City’s nine larger economic centres and many smaller local centres, where most people live, visit, work and play. These areas typically include older neighbourhoods, many built at a time when streets did not require footpaths. Coverage: Lake Macquarie, New South Wales. The portal files it under Infrastructure and Communications. Its keywords are Cycling, Pedestrian, Wayfinding, Planning, Pathways, Cycleways. The portal shows 34 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-09-27 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-3.0-AU. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lakemac-com-au-portal.
